title: My Brother Forged Papers And Locked Me Out Of Mom's Store. So I Watched Him Convict Himself.
description: For twenty years I ran our family's antique jewelry store, but the day after Mom's funeral my brother forged the deed and locked me out. Then I found a Hi8 tape hidden in her armoire where he confessed the whole scheme. Now he polishes silver in my renamed shop 'Forged in Greed Jewelers' wearing a tie that reads 'Heir of Deception,' and every appraisal certificate cites his perjury case. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #JusticeServed
thumb_text: HIS 10-YEAR-OLD CONFESSION GAVE ME THE STORE
pinned_comment: If your own brother locked you out of your family's store after the funeral and you found a hidden tape of him admitting the forgery, what would you do? Share your story in the comments.
